hero.body: The Anderseed Mentorship Programme is built around one goal: making you employable, not just knowledgeable. Through practical projects, personalised mentorship, and our Signature Job Application Guide, you'll build the skills, confidence, and real-world experience employers value most.
hero.subline: Find clarity. Build confidence. Become a Business Analyst.

programme.label: The programme
programme.title: Everything you need to become BA-ready
programme.intro: A structured mentorship programme that blends practical learning, live coaching, real-world projects, and career support to accelerate your journey into Business Analysis.
programme.featuredText: Hands-on BA training across the end-to-end software development lifecycle. Practise requirements gathering, process mapping, stakeholder conversations, documentation, and real project thinking with mentor feedback and accountability.

process.label: How it works
process.title: Your BA journey, mapped like a real project.
process.intro: A clear route from beginner to supported BA professional, with practical training, live project experience, job-readiness, and ongoing career support.

steps.title: Choose programme
steps.text: Select the mentorship path that matches your current stage, goals, and level of BA confidence.

steps.title: Get onboarded
steps.text: Join smoothly and receive access to premium training, resources, mentor guidance, and your support community.

steps.title: Learn and take action
steps.text: Work through BA concepts, practical tasks, and live project scenarios that mirror real workplace expectations.

steps.title: Build confidence
steps.text: Strengthen your BA language, stakeholder thinking, documentation skills, and ability to explain your work clearly.

steps.title: Get hired
steps.text: Use your CV, LinkedIn, job application strategy, and interview preparation to move confidently toward BA roles.

steps.title: Lifetime job support group
steps.text: Stay connected after the programme with career check-ins, peer support, job leads, and continued accountability.
